questions.question: It was not until I had finished my studies that I realized the true value of a university education.
options: I didn't realize the value of a university education until after I'd finished my studies.
I only realized the value of a university education when I finished my studies.
The value of a university education wasn't clear to me until after I had finished my studies.
It was only after finishing my studies that I realized the true value of a university education.
questions.answer: I didn't realize the value of a university education until after I'd finished my studies.

questions.question: Had she been more careful, the accident might have been avoided.
options: If she had been more careful, the accident would have been avoided.
She was not careful enough to avoid the accident.
The accident occurred because she wasn't careful.
Being more careful wouldn't have prevented the accident.
questions.answer: If she had been more careful, the accident would have been avoided.

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the party, they had already eaten most of the food.
options: Most of the food had been eaten by the time I arrived at the party.
I was too late for dinner as most of the food had already been eaten.
When I got to the party, all that was left was a few snacks.
The majority of the food was still intact when I arrived.
questions.answer: Most of the food had been eaten by the time I arrived at the party.

questions.question: It is essential that students are taught how to think critically and solve complex problems.
options: Students should be able to think critically and solve complex problems.
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are not as important as other subjects.
It's crucial for students to learn critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Teaching students to think critically is a waste of time.
questions.answer: It's crucial for students to learn critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

questions.question: Unless the company changes its policy, it will be difficult to meet the new targets.
options: The company needs to change its policy in order to meet the new targets.
If the company doesn't change its policy, meeting the new targets will be challenging.
Changing the policy is not a priority for the company at this time.
Meeting the new targets won't be an issue if the company sticks with its current policy.
questions.answer: If the company doesn't change its policy, meeting the new targets will be challenging.
